flags.message: Decisive forward signal from public pre-snapshot material: the companion Illinois Brick petition United Biologics v. Amerigroup Tennessee, No. 25-1388 (CA6), was distributed on 2026-09-02 for the same 9/28/2026 conference as this petition (read from the public supremecourt.gov docket page). The BIO in this case names it. It raised my grant number and my hold/GVR path; it is not outcome material for this case, whose conference has not yet occurred.

context.distribution_count is 2, but the docket shows the first DISTRIBUTED (for 5/14/2026) was superseded by the Court's Response Requested order of 4/30/2026, and the second pair (8/05 distributed, 8/25 rescheduled, 9/02 redistributed for the same 9/28 conference) reflects a reschedule before first consideration. The petition has not yet been considered at any conference, so the frozen count overstates true relists (zero); the relist-increment claim is stated from the count as frozen.
